versions.changelog:
- Added comprehensive documentation (SKILL.md) detailing all supported widget types, usage examples, and action handling.
- Included quick start instructions for integrating widgets in React/Next.js via ui.inference.sh.
- Listed available layout, typography, interactive, and display widget types with configuration samples.
- Provided example widgets for flight cards and forms.
- Documented available background gradients and how to use them.
- Linked to related skills and external documentation for further reference.

widgets-ui 0.1.0

- Initial release introducing a declarative JSON-to-React/Next.js UI widget renderer.
- Supports dynamic forms, cards, buttons, layouts, selects, inputs, checkboxes, badges, icons, and more.
- Easily render interactive UIs from agent responses or structured JSON data.
- Quick integration via npx and shadcn.
- Includes example usage, schema references, and links to related agent and UI skills.
